result.changelog: All error and noncanon items fixed. Doomseye now destroyed by the Federation fleet after the Federation Force disabled its shield. Tanamaar is now a planet in the Desolan System. The 74% Elite ratio now pleased High Command, which expected more, in both entries that used it. The Omega Pirate lifespan line now matches its source. Gandrayda herself, not officers, moved among the troops. Kihunter manual quote replaced with the actual Super Metroid manual wording. The Orpheon self-destruct was set off by the Parasite Queen falling into the reactor. Dark Pirate Commando locations moved to Torvus, Dark Torvus, Temple Grounds and Ing Hive. Militia removed from the Homeworld defenders. Militia promotion (cut content) removed. 'Violence' removed from Phazon madness symptoms. Wiki inferences removed (Aqua Pirates searching for survivors, Colossus scrapped). Unverified items checked: the Super Metroid manual trading-ships clause was confirmed and kept. 'Failure to comply' quote replaced with the confirmed 'Command grows impatient' line. Fission/Hunter Metroid attribution, Urtraghus/SN-883, the Beyond Metroid-control 'it is believed' claim, 'to finish them off', the Commander superlative and 'flagship' were removed or softened. Technician 12, the Aether Metroid experiments and the Aerotrooper 'traded armor for evasion' line now follow their sources. Valhalla 'Phazon-powered weapons' confirmed. The Aether 'overpowered by the Ing and the hunters' outcome confirmed. Added: Weavel, the crashed Aether frigate, the Colossus's earlier plans, the Federation's use of the Leviathan battleship, and Gandrayda's corruption and death. Also added the Hazard Shield and shield shutdown details, unit locations, Aerotrooper and Commando counters, Phazon Beam, the Federation Police arrest on Jigrad, the King Kihunter young-Ridley screech, gold Zebesian mimics and the 'Metroids are not pets' line. Zoro corrected to pupal form (larva is Zero). Command subdivision names corrected. Dynamo workers, not miners. Style: every non-overview entry trimmed to 400 words or fewer (overview 529). Game titles cut to 2 or fewer parenthetical tags per entry. Manual citations rewritten so titles appear only in parentheses. Removed meta words and editorial lines. Keys: added Colossus, Vol Paragom, Space Coffin, Pirate ATC, Aqua Pirate, Zoro/Zoros, Ki-Hunter, and plurals. Dropped redundant keys already matched by a shorter key, plus 'acid rain', Urtraghus, SN-883 and Pirate Research. Space Pirate(s) keys stay only on the overview (as secondary disambiguators on the selective Samus entry).
result.unresolved: Some details rest only on the fact-check report's own Metroid Wiki fetches and were not re-fetched here: Gandrayda's corruption and death, the 'Metroids are not pets' protocol, the Fusion gold Zebesian, and the Nova Beam/X-Ray shield shutdown. Prime 4: Beyond Pirate unit types remain unavailable. 'Dark Hunter' fires only alongside a Pirate secondary key (accepted trade-off). Several key overlaps with the prime1 domain (Omega Pirate, Phazon Mines, Glacier One, Orpheon) are intentional. Three Ships keys were cut for the 12-key cap: Boarding Pods plural, Siriacus, Vortex Outpost. Two Troop-types keys were also cut for the cap: Pirate Grenadiers plural and the Power/Wave/Ice/Plasma Trooper names.
